# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security problems privately through GitHub: **Security** tab >
**Report a vulnerability**
(https://github.com/verifymzansi-VM/verifymzansi-VM/security/advisories/new).

Do not open a public issue, and do not include real people's personal data in a
report. Tell us what you found, how to reproduce it, and what an attacker could
do with it.

We will acknowledge your report as soon as we can and keep you updated until the
problem is fixed.

## Testing rules

- Test only against accounts you own. Never access, change or delete other
  people's data, ID documents or phone numbers.
- Do not run automated scanners or load tests against verifymzansi.com.
- Do not use social engineering, phishing or physical attacks.

## Supported versions

Only the version currently deployed at https://verifymzansi.com is supported.
